context_window: se files are recommended by the US Library of Congress as a storage format for long-term preservation of digital content. SQLite allows database files to have any desired filename extension, so an application can choose a custom filename extension for its own use, if desired. The application_id pragma can be used to set an "Application ID" integer in the database file so that tools like file(1) can determine that the file is associated with your application and is not just a generic SQL database.

minimum_success_condition: file(1)의 파일 유형 판별 도구 정보에 도착해야 한다. 홈페이지 도달만으로 특정 SQLite application_id 판별 지원까지 입증되는 것은 아니다.
